import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures

# Dataset for polynomial feature generation
data = {
    'x1': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'x2': [2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create PolynomialFeatures with degree=2
poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, include_bias=False)

# Fit and transform the data
df_poly = poly.fit_transform(df)

# Get feature names and create dataframe
feature_names = poly.get_feature_names_out(df.columns)
df_poly = pd.DataFrame(df_poly, columns=feature_names)

# Print the original and polynomial feature dataframes
print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)
print("\nPolynomial Features (degree=2):")
print(df_poly)
